coordinates.object_orientation: Head -Y, tail+Y, up+Z. Folded-wing four-contact standing pose.

concept.reason: Primary Fig1B and official skull cast photo inspected; no generated concept.

scope: Original genus-level whole organism. Choose better-known Q.lawsoni; retain long straight neck, huge pointed beak, tall walking limbs, folded wings. Not isolated skull or giant Q.northropi.
specimen_basis: TMM41961-1 holotype includes partial skull, cervicals and limb elements, not complete skeleton. Andres/Langston2021 Fig1B combines holotype/referred/inferred bones, explicitly colour-coded; UT skull image is a cast with sculpted missing areas.

scale.basis: Andres/Langston2021 p47 and diagnosis; species estimate not pose bounding-box width. Reject mixing10m Q.northropi or18–20ft press number.
scale.constructed_path_note: Approximate straightened sum of shoulder-to-wrist plus single fourth-finger control-path lengths and 0.28 m shoulder spacing. Close to 4.5 m reference, not a fossil measurement or folded bounding box.

diagnostic_targets: Long mostly straight neck projects upward from compact torso; long slender toothless pointed bill and restrained rear cranial crest.
Tall four-contact grounded pose, with separate hind feet and wing wrists; folded fourth wing fingers extend upward/backward, not bat fingers or extra limbs.
Membranes visibly folded against flank, short tail, no feathers or tooth rows.
uncertainties: Soft tissue, membrane attachment/outline, skin colour and static pose are inferred.
Do not reproduce bone openings as holes in living flesh.
Folded pose height/length are artistic proportions, not measured holotype;4.5m is unfolded span reference.
acceptance_checks: Whole body visible, long neck/bill/tall grounded silhouette from side and perspective.
Exactly two hindlimbs plus two forelimb-wings, four stable ground contacts; no floating wing tips.
Original mesh/materials, no fossil/artist image textures.
handoff_contract: Same localdir prep/maker/QA; maker fixedhash COMPLETE then stop. Root asynchronous backup; retain local for integration, no maker upload/cleanup.
origin: Center of four intended contact regions. Root identity; geometry y shifted +0.17 m.
material_profile: Five original opaque palette-only Principled materials. No reference-image texture.
required_maker_gates: Static GLB audit and source-export bounds
Four exact-GLB images and maker inspection
